verified_isp_run.programmer: Arduino Uno running ArduinoISP, STK500v1 at 19200 baud
verified_isp_run.original_memories: Flash and EEPROM were blank; complete backups were verified against a second read before writing.
verified_isp_run.verification: Flash write verification and fresh-session whole-flash readback matched the intended image including its erased tail; EEPROM was unchanged.
verified_isp_run.reported_supply: Earlier user-reported 3.3 V target supply and 3.2 V front-capacitor reading; no voltage was measured by the programming tool.
verified_isp_run.backup_policy: Binary backups and tool logs remain outside the repository.
verified_isp_run.limitations: One verified programming run, not an IR-functional, contact-life, current/temperature or electrical safety qualification.

reported_5v_setup.source: User report: 5V power rail works in practice.
reported_5v_setup.documented_connection: White lead from Uno 5V to probe J1.2; black common GND; CR2032 removed; no second target supply.
reported_5v_setup.signal_levels: 5 V target power matches the Uno's 5 V ISP signals. A 3.3 V target still requires suitable level translation or a matching programmer.
reported_5v_setup.limitations: User-reported practical operation; not a separately instrumented or readback-verified 5 V run, nor qualification of every populated component or LED load.
